posts.title: One Person at a Time
posts.description: As engineers, we love abstraction: but when applied to leadership, efficiency can quickly cross into cruelty. A reflection on managing large engineering teams without reducing people to headcount, ditching sterile scripts, and remembering that culture is built in the hardest, quietest moments.
